styleLock.direction: quiet drafting-paper commerce for feminine care
styleLock.backgroundSystem: two alternating printed-paper fields only: a matte cotton-rag paper field #F6F8F5 ruled with a hairline #DCE5EA grid and carrying one dashed #2E7FA6 die-cut outline of the product silhouette, and a card-stock plane #DCE5EA used for comparison, variant and card screens; dark closing screens use a plain #1F3B4D panel with one hairline #2E7FA6 rule. Never a photographed room, never a bathroom, never a bed, never a candy-pink gradient field, never clouds, petals or sparkles.
styleLock.lightingSystem: one low raking key near 6000K entering from the right about 30 degrees above the paper, so every object throws one long soft shadow to the left; a weak cool bounce from the left only, never a front fill; macro and edge screens swap the key for one narrow hard grazing band from the right that gives each peeled step its own thin highlight; dark closing screens use one narrow side sweep from the right. Contact shadows are always believable and the product never floats.
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte cotton-rag paper field #F6F8F5, card-stock plane #DCE5EA, one plain #1F3B4D board. No marble, no wood, no tile, no linen or towel weave, no milk or liquid surface, no water mirror, no wet reflection, no floor.
styleLock.typography: one narrow condensed grotesque family; a single tight-tracking headline line set either bare in #1F3B4D or inside a solid #1F3B4D bar, with one hairline #2E7FA6 latin rail beneath it; short ruled label rails only, no dense body paragraphs, no outlined bubble lettering, no rounded cartoon type, no handwritten script.
styleLock.iconSystem: single-weight hairline #2E7FA6 drafting pictograms only: dashed die-cut outlines of the product shape, corner tick crosses, leader lines ending in a small square terminal, empty square frames and empty outlined discs used as unlabeled step marks; no filled badges, no certification seals, no shield or leaf motifs, no gradient icons, no 3D pictograms, no numerals inside any disc.
styleLock.presentationRules: the pad keeps the reference outline, wing form, surface quilting, dashed side seams, back-sheet pattern and colourway exactly; the pack keeps its own silhouette, gusset and printed placement with no invented legible lettering; products are photographed as clean pack-and-pad studies on the paper field, never worn, held, placed on or beside a body, garment or underwear; human presence is not used at all; every proof slot, seal frame and grid cell stays an empty rail; vertical edges of the pack stay strictly vertical.
noDrift: no colour palette changes outside #F6F8F5, #DCE5EA, #1F3B4D and #2E7FA6

provenance.notes:

【逐屏事实】panel-01：糖果粉网格底，中央一片卡通绘制的护翼巾面（白色巾体、浅蓝中央导流带、蓝色虚线侧缝、左右护翼），立于粉色圆台与云棉之上，右侧一位蓝发橙色裙卡通精灵与飘落花瓣，顶部两行描边泡泡大字「舒适卫生巾 给你最好的呵护」，下方切浅粉区放两行标题与「22+12+7」组合数字；panel-02：上一屏延续的 22+12+7 数字行，下方白色圆角产品信息卡（左侧灰色空图位，右侧六行：品牌为微立体可爱风-卫生巾、片数为日用14片*240mm*1包、生产日期2020年2月、保质期三年、适用人群为追求舒适健康安全生活的女性、使用方法建议每2-3小时更换），再下方为分区标题加六枚白色空白卡（各配一行烦恼短句：移位侧漏巾身不服帖、硬邦邦一块怎么动都不舒服、量多潮涌突然涌出）；panel-03：同一卡通巾面的四枚粉色胶囊标签加细线引线（动态负离子杀菌除味、纳米银深入杀菌修复再生、远红外促进微循环抗衰老两条重复），说明行为深入肌体带出血块炎症污物分解祛除经期异味；panel-04：STEP1 至 STEP3 三枚灰色空图位加同一段撕开背面中间离型纸将卫生巾紧贴于内裤中央文字（三格文字完全重复），上方一行建议每两小时更换一次卫生巾能有效防止细菌生长，下方粉色块内七条经期建议（饮食、心情、补水、熬夜、有氧运动、丰胸最佳时期与坚果豆类）；panel-05：两张真人臀腿实拍（肤色与黑色安全裤，仅腰到大腿出镜）各配一枚粉色胶囊标题超柔棉置身云朵般的柔软世界与一段天然有机棉减少摩擦系数说明；panel-06：两列完全重复的参数表（产品表面超绵柔表层、产品长度155mm、包装规格1包/20片、主要材料为超柔无纺布植物纤维芯片膨化纸吸水纸热熔胶离型纸透气底膜）与左下角黑色「加入会员 全店免费」角标加二维码。
